title: Three Years and One Short Lever
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：tape　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tape 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the engineer ① played the tape that no worker in the workshop would have described, and he said the playing was the whole of the year. The ② tape, meaning the strip itself and not the lever, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; a tape, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ tape in that workshop had the same short lever beside it, and the ④ tape at the far bench, meaning the part they kept for the children to fit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A tape, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the engineer said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the tape was the whole of the matter, meaning the memory and not the strip. The ⑥ tape, meaning the memory and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; tape, he said, is either something you play or the only word that means both a strip and a memory. He said the memory is the part they remember.

By 1987 the ⑦ tape had become a line in a manual, and the manual had become an argument about the short lever. The ⑧ tape of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in April, was one workshop and three years of describing; tape, he said, is either the part at the far bench or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ tape I remember is the strip described in the manual, which closed in 1989 and is still described as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ tape, my mother said in 1991, is the only strip that improves by being described; every tape, she said, is a memory that has agreed to look like a strip. She said the memory was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 磁带；胶带（指车间里每一盘旁边的那一盘）
B. n. 磁带；胶带（指那盘磁带本身，与短短的拉杆相对）
C. 固定搭配：play the tape 放这一盘磁带
D. n. 磁带；胶带（指留给孩子们装的那一件）
E. n. 磁带之事（抽象总称，指一处车间的磁带之事）
F. n. 磁带；胶带（指说明书里写到、被描述的那一盘）
G. n. 磁带、留存（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 留存（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: played the tape that no worker in the workshop would have described
The tape, meaning the strip itself and not the lever
the tape at the far bench
the tape was the whole of the matter

The tape of the whole thing

answers.why: play the tape 意为“放这一盘磁带”，1982 年那位工程师把车间里没有一位工人肯描述的一盘磁带做了一遍。
tape 意为“磁带；胶带”，指那盘磁带本身而不是短短的拉杆，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被描述。
tape 意为“磁带；胶带”，指车间里每一盘旁边的那一盘，每一盘旁边都有同一根短短的拉杆。
tape 意为“磁带；胶带”，指最远那张工作台的留给孩子们装的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
tape 意为“磁带、留存”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这盘留存就是那件事的全部。
tape 意为“留存”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那盘磁带，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
tape 意为“磁带；胶带”，指说明书里写到、被描述的那一盘，到 1987 年这一盘成了说明书里的一行。
tape 意为“磁带之事”，工程师四月写道，整件事的磁带之事是一处车间和三个年头的描述。
tape 意为“磁带；胶带”，我记得的是说明书里描述过的那一盘，1989 年装好了，至今仍被说成车间里最安静的一盘。
tape 为抽象总称，母亲 1991 年说，磁带是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的磁带。
